title: Modernize legacy debian/rules with debhelper 13+ sequencer
input: A legacy Debian source package uses explicit calls to `dh_install`, `dh_strip`, `dh_makeshlibs`, and manual configure scripts in debian/rules. How should this be modernized to debhelper-compat 13 with proper overrides?
evidence_requirements: Declaration of debhelper-compat (= 13) in Build-Depends or debian/control
Use of override_dh_auto_configure and override_dh_auto_test for customizations

title: Audit debian/control for Multi-Arch, architecture tags, and dynamic substitutions
input:
Audit this debian/control snippet: `Package: libfoo1 
 Architecture: all 
 Depends: libc6, libssl3`. What errors exist and how must Multi-Arch and runtime dependencies be corrected?
evidence_requirements: Correction of Architecture: any for compiled shared library
Addition of Multi-Arch: same for co-installable multiarch library
Replacement of manual libc6/libssl3 dependencies with ${shlibs:Depends} and ${misc:Depends}

title: Diagnose missing Build-Depends in clean chroot build
input: A Debian package compiles cleanly on a developer's workstation but fails in sbuild with `make: cmake: command not found` and `ninja: fatal: ninja not found`. Why did this happen and how is it resolved?
evidence_requirements: Identification of undeclared dependencies present on developer host but absent in minimal chroot
Addition of cmake and ninja-build to Build-Depends in debian/control
Verification using clean sbuild or chroot build

title: Author DEP-3 compliant quilt patch for upstream bugfix
input: An upstream C library has a NULL pointer dereference bug in `parser.c`. We need to backport the fix to a Debian package using quilt. How should the patch be created and documented?
evidence_requirements: Creation of patch under debian/patches/ with registration in debian/patches/series
Inclusion of mandatory DEP-3 headers (Description, Author, Origin, Bug-Debian, Forwarded)
Use of quilt push/refresh or gbp pq for patch workflow

title: Troubleshoot isolated sbuild failure and missing test environment
input: During sbuild on Debian Sid, the build passes compilation but fails during `dh_auto_test` with `Cannot connect to D-Bus session bus`. How should this test failure be addressed in debian/rules without disabling tests entirely?
evidence_requirements: Identification of missing headless D-Bus session daemon in isolated chroot
Wrapping test execution with dbus-run-session in override_dh_auto_test

title: Configure autopkgtest integration for installed binary verification
input: A Debian package maintainer wants to add DEP-8 continuous integration tests to verify that the compiled binary executes properly once installed on a target system. How is autopkgtest configured?
evidence_requirements: Declaration of Tests or Test-Command and Depends: @
Explanation that autopkgtest tests the installed binary package in a clean testbed rather than the source build tree
